name: Mavacamten

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for heart harm

similar.name: Mebanazine
problems: Pulled from the market in United Kingdom, first in 1975 — for liver harm

examples.title: A Study of Mavacamten in Non-Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
examples.why: Trial terminated because of lack of efficacy in the short term acute phase

examples.title: ENABLE-HCM - AI-ENabled Echocardiography With Ultrasound Beyond the Echo Lab for Better HCM Imaging and Expanded Access
examples.why: The sponsor terminated the study following an internal review of program priorities.

summary: In the United States, Mavacamten carries a boxed warning for heart harm [3]. A small computer model, not tests on people, gave it a medium score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M]. A similar drug named Mebanazine was removed from the market in the United Kingdom due to liver harm [4]. Additionally, a clinical study of Mavacamten was ended early because the drug did not work as well as hoped during its initial phase [6].
